segments.name: Software-as-a-Service
segments.evidence: ReposiTrak, Inc., a Nevada corporation (" ReposiTrak ", " We ", " us ", "our" or the " Company ") is a Software-as-a-Service (" SaaS ") company that operates a business-to-business ('B2B') e-commerce, compliance, traceability and supply chain management platform.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for its SaaS platform and services, including cash payments for services provided under service agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: Under the terms of the Agreement, the Company agreed to provide certain services (the " Services ") to the Client for a one-year term beginning March 13, 2026.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company changed its corporate name from Park City Group, Inc. to ReposiTrak, Inc.
changes.evidence: on December 21, 2023, the Company effected a change of its corporate name from Park City Group, Inc. to ReposiTrak, Inc., pursuant to a short-form merger with its wholly owned subsidiary, ReposiTrak, Inc., a Utah corporation, with the Company remaining as the surviving entity.
